title: Reviews
intro: See what customers say about your shop and reply to them. Your reply is shown under the review on your shop page.
noComment: The customer gave a rating without a written comment.

none.title: No reviews yet
none.text: Customers can review a visit after it is finished. Their reviews will show up here.

all.title: No reviews
all.text: There are no reviews to show.

needsReply.title: Nothing waiting for a reply
needsReply.text: You have replied to every review. New reviews will show up here.

replied.title: No replies yet
replied.text: Reviews that you have replied to will show up here.

filtered.title: No reviews with this rating
filtered.text: Choose a different rating to see more reviews.

dialog.title: Reply to review
dialog.label: Your reply
dialog.hint: Be polite and keep it about the visit. Everyone who opens your shop page can read it.
dialog.empty: Write a reply before you send it.
dialog.tooLong: The reply can have at most {{max}} characters.

toast.failed: Could not save the reply. Please try again.
